document.title: Security audit 2026-11-07 (12): always-on-top question box in verify-windows.ps1

acknowledgments.summary: audit of pull request test/windows-verify before merge, directed by the maintainer

notes.title: Summary
notes.text: Audit of the change that shows the context bar question with the Windows MessageBoxW function and the MB_TOPMOST flag, after the maintainer found the WinForms dialog from log 11 ended up behind OBS. No security issues found.

notes.title: Audit details
notes.text: The script declares one P/Invoke signature, user32.dll MessageBoxW, in the type NixieVerify.NativeV1, guarded so a re-run in the same session reuses it. It is called with no owner window, fixed text from the script, and the flags MB_YESNO, MB_ICONQUESTION, MB_SETFOREGROUND and MB_TOPMOST; only the button result (IDYES) is used. MB_TOPMOST keeps the box above other windows until the tester answers; it does not change any other window or system setting. The WinForms owner form from log 11 is removed.

notes.title: Result
notes.text: No findings. Logged as required by the project's audit policy.
